member.name: M:BoardSync.Api.Modules.OrgProject.Repositories.Interfaces.IOrganizationRepository.ExecuteInTransactionAsync(System.Func{System.Threading.CancellationToken,System.Threading.Tasks.Task},System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary:
Runs inside a single database transaction, retried as a unit.
Needed because creating an organization also writes a role assignment owned by the RBAC module, which saves through its own service — so the work cannot be folded into one . Every repository and service in a request shares the same scoped DbContext, so their writes enlist in this transaction automatically. Wrapping in the execution strategy is mandatory here: EnableRetryOnFailure refuses to retry a user-initiated transaction otherwise.
